"""The same decision taken exactly.

The bracket is written over a common denominator, the numerator is expanded into
a canonical polynomial form over the rationals, and it is zero exactly when every
coefficient is zero. That is a comparison of exact integers rather than a
judgement, and it is decidable.
"""

from sympy import Poly


def bracket_vanishes(bracket, generators):
    numerator, _ = bracket.as_numer_denom()
    return Poly(numerator.expand(), *generators).is_zero
